hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE_PATH=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$FILE_PATH" in */frontend/src/*|*/backend/src/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; TODAY=$(date +%Y-%m-%d); SPECS_DIR="/home/user/mxo-track/docs/superpowers/specs"; if ls "$SPECS_DIR"/${TODAY}-*.md 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"FULL-FLOW GATE: No spec file found for today ($TODAY) in docs/superpowers/specs/. Follow CLAUDE.md Full-flow: Consult decisions -> Brainstorm (Skill 2) -> write spec -> Plan (Skill 3) -> then implement. Do NOT edit source code without completing brainstorming and writing a spec first.\"}}"'

PostToolUse.command: bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE" == /root/.claude/plans/* ]]; then BASENAME=$(basename "$FILE"); DATE=$(date +%Y-%m-%d); DEST_DIR="/home/user/mxo-track/docs/superpowers/plans/conversation"; mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"; DEST="$DEST_DIR/${DATE}-${BASENAME}"; cp "$FILE" "$DEST" && cd /home/user/mxo-track && git add "$DEST" && git commit -m "docs: persist conversation plan ${DATE}-${BASENAME}" && git push; fi'
